description: Executable engine microbenchmark matrix. Budgets are acceptance targets; individual reports contain measured outcomes.
measurement_notes: Run every sample_rate × block_size × voice_count combination after warmup, with deterministic events generated from seed.
duration_seconds is the measured render duration; warmup_seconds is excluded from timing statistics.
render_time metrics cover engine.process, event dispatch, DSP, voice mixing and bounded synchronous capture; they exclude the device callback, host wrapper, Analyzer and GUI.
Convert microseconds to seconds before comparing callback duration with deadline_seconds.
rt_allocations and rt_deallocations count heap allocation and release on the audio callback thread during measurement; both must remain zero.
voice_state_bytes measures memory held by voice DSP state; voice_instance_count and sounding_voice_count distinguish allocated instances from voices currently sounding.
For held_chord, press all requested voices at the same sample at warmup start, using pitch_start + index * pitch_step; keep every voice held throughout measurement.
For repeating_case, repeat only the referenced case events at period_seconds offsets from warmup start; rename note_id in each cycle to keep note identities distinct.
Trim warmup from statistics without resetting engine state or the workload clock; measure the following duration_seconds and omit events at or beyond the render end.
Compare probe off/on on the same DSP program, with all named signals retained as potential taps; do not compare programs with different dead-code elimination semantics.

capture_config records signal IDs, voice selectors, channels, full-rate sample rate, ring duration and capture budget; analysis_windows records transform sizes and hop lengths. The native live transport has 128 fixed capture packets of up to 1024 samples and 8 mono channels; its buffered duration depends on callback size. This offline benchmark uses a synchronous bounded capture sink.
Record zero or an explicit empty configuration for absent captures/assets/GUI, and not_applicable for offline driver/host fields; never omit fingerprint fields silently.
Measure hot-swap and maximum capture separately from steady-state profiles; include simultaneous program count, scratch/capture memory and retired program peak memory in the report.
Record the machine, build, engine revision, compiler revision and working-tree source hashes with every execution.
